item.title: Version 0.6.2
item.description:
What's New

  • Web wallpapers imported from the Workshop now run with the network cut off. They render as before, but they cannot reach out — no fetch, no WebSocket, no WebRTC, and it does not depend on finding a setting
  • Scene wallpapers respond to the cursor: layers receive enter, leave, move and click, so a scene can put a song list or a button on your desktop
  • Settings search works in Chinese, Japanese and English alike, instead of matching English keys only
  • The inspector's resize handle can be driven from the keyboard and is reachable with VoiceOver

Improvements

  • Measuring the Steam library no longer blocks the interface; Settings stays responsive while it counts
  • Floating cards fall back to an opaque style under Reduce Transparency and gain a border under Increase Contrast
  • Backups move between Lite and Pro — a .lwconfig exported from one edition imports into the other
  • The system-wallpaper extension keeps file paths out of its logs
  • HTML diagnostics read in your language rather than English
  • boxrandom particle emitters spread the way the reference engine spreads them, and an emitter type we do not simulate stays idle with a diagnostic instead of pretending to be a sphere
  • Light objects keep their authored type instead of being flattened to "point"

Bug Fixes

  • Settings could be lost after an interrupted write: the last good copy is now kept instead of being overwritten by the damaged one
  • A scene script that set up its state in applyUserProperties computed its first frame from nothing, which rendered text at zero scale
  • Hovering a scene layer hit-tested upside down, so the top of a list highlighted the bottom entry
  • A click now lands on the layer that was under the cursor when the button went down, not the one from the frame before
  • Album art reached builtin image passes, which previously left the authored placeholder in place
  • Storage could report an empty wallpaper library when the engine assets alongside it were large

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
